name: To the Depths and Back
source:
You take up the role of Lynx, a neko (catgirl) storyteller who joins an adventuring dynamic duo, Holly and Cinnamon, in their quest to make away with the treasures of the Lataran Temple. But just as they near their goal, things start taking an ominous turn as she begins to question her teammates' intentions.

Set in the world of Felarya, belonging to [url=http://www.karbo.deviantart.com]Karbo[/url].

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=24765&sid=c979e19200c82db822393f1c76d50cef]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演猫娘说书人莱恩克丝，与活力十足的冒险搭档霍莉和肉桂一同踏上旅程，目标是夺走拉塔兰神庙的宝藏。然而，就在她们即将达成目标时，莱恩克丝开始质疑队友的意图，事情也逐渐转向不祥。

故事发生在[url=http://www.karbo.deviantart.com]Karbo[/url]所属的费拉莉亚世界。

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=29&t=24765&sid=c979e19200c82db822393f1c76d50cef]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
